speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To narrow down the cause, have you noticed any jaundice, such as yellowing of your skin or eyes, or dark urine recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatitis C infection (chronic hepatitis).

Thank you for that information. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, inconsistent condom use with multiple partners, and symptoms of fatigue, pruritus, and abnormal liver enzymes, we must prioritize ruling out viral hepatitis. Did you ever have blood transfusions or IV drug use in the past?
